result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a loading spinner overlaid on an already fully rendered image, suggesting a stuck/never-resolved loading state. There is also a small inconsistency in the styling of the favorite (heart) buttons between cards.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card even though the card image and all text (name, rating, delivery time, fee) are fully loaded. This looks like a stuck loading indicator and obscures the food image.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner once the image/content has finished loading (tie its visibility to the actual load state), and add a timeout/fallback so it never remains over rendered content.

issues.description: The favorite heart button on the first 'Popular right now' card has no background scrim, while the second card's heart sits on a dark circular background. The inconsistent treatment reduces legibility of the first icon against busy imagery.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent dark circular background to all favorite buttons for consistency and reliable contrast over any image.
